slide_title: Effect of small and large Learning Rate

layout.arrangement: title top-center in red; slide number in yellow circle top-right; two side-by-side chart panels below title, each with a bold heading above a plotted loss curve; axes drawn with red arrows; thin rectangular border encloses both chart panels

regions.name: slide number
regions.content: yellow filled circle with black number 28

regions.name: left chart panel
regions.content: heading 'Small Learning Rate' above a U-shaped blue loss curve with small descending steps shown by dots and line segments; red y-axis labeled Loss, red x-axis labeled Value of weight

regions.name: right chart panel
regions.content: heading 'Large Learning Rate' above a U-shaped blue loss curve with large oscillating steps shown by dots and line segments crossing the minimum; red y-axis labeled Loss, red x-axis labeled Value of weight

layout.hierarchy: title dominates by color and size; chart headings are secondary; curves and step paths are the visual focus; axis labels are smallest

visual_elements.description: Left panel: U-shaped (parabolic) loss curve in blue; y-axis 'Loss' with red upward arrow; x-axis 'Value of weight' with red rightward arrow; a sequence of ~6 small dots with short connecting line segments descends along the left arm of the curve toward the minimum, with a tiny arrow near the bottom pointing at the valley

Right panel: U-shaped (parabolic) loss curve in blue; y-axis 'Loss' with red upward arrow; x-axis 'Value of weight' with red rightward arrow; four larger dots connected by long line segments oscillate across the valley: start high on left arm, jump to high on right arm, back to lower left, then to higher right, illustrating overshooting
thin dark blue/purple rectangular border framing the two chart panels together

typography_notes: sans-serif throughout; title is bold red and larger than body; chart headings are bold black; axis labels are regular black; slide number is black inside a yellow circle
animation_state: static; all elements fully visible, no partial build
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white. 2. Add title text box at top: 'Effect of small and large Learning Rate' in bold red sans-serif, centered/left-aligned. 3. Add a yellow filled circle at top-right with black text '28'. 4. Draw a thin dark-blue rectangular border around the central chart area. 5. Left panel: add bold black heading 'Small Learning Rate'; draw red y-axis arrow pointing up labeled 'Loss' and red x-axis arrow pointing right labeled 'Value of weight'; sketch a blue U-shaped parabola; place ~6 small blue dots along the left descending arm with short line segments between them showing tiny steps toward the minimum; add a small arrow near the valley. 6. Right panel: add bold black heading 'Large Learning Rate'; draw identical red axes labeled 'Loss' and 'Value of weight'; sketch a blue U-shaped parabola; place four blue dots with long connecting lines that oscillate across the minimum (left-high to right-high to left-lower to right-higher). 7. Ensure curve color is medium blue, arrows are red, and all text is black except the red title.
